Licence: the MINIX 3 licence (LICENSE), a BSD three-clause licence from the
Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam: redistribution with the copyright notice and
disclaimer, no use of the names for endorsement. The vendored files carry no
licence notice of their own and fall under it. Its closing sentence ("Any
deviations from these conditions require written permission from the
copyright holder in advance") restates that permission beyond the three
conditions must be sought; it adds no condition on redistribution under
them. On that reading the files may be combined into, and conveyed as part
of, a GPL-3.0-only work such as OpenRFS, keeping LICENSE with them.

Vendored paths (byte-for-byte upstream; SOURCE-MANIFEST.sha256):
  minix/drivers/audio/es1370/es1370.c, es1370.h   Ensoniq AudioPCI ES1370
  minix/drivers/audio/es1370/ak4531.c, ak4531.h   its AK4531 codec
  minix/drivers/audio/es1370/pci_helper.c, pci_helper.h
  minix/drivers/audio/sb16/sb16.c, sb16.h         Sound Blaster 16 (ISA)
  minix/drivers/audio/sb16/mixer.c, mixer.h       its mixer
  minix/drivers/audio/sb16/README
  minix/include/minix/audio_fw.h                  the drv_* interface
  minix/include/minix/sound.h
  minix/include/sys/ioc_sound.h                   the DSPIO*/MIXIO* codes
  LICENSE

Deliberately not vendored: libaudiodriver (minix/lib/libaudiodriver), whose
playback path ports/minix/audio_glue.c reproduces for OpenRFS, and every
MINIX system header; ports/minix/include declares the part of MINIX's
system library the drivers use. es1370/AC97.h is not included by any
vendored file and is left out.
